property_summary: For any non-empty _tos, transfer(...) either returns true without reverting and makes all external transferFrom calls succeed, or it reverts; in particular, transfer(...) cannot return false — if it returns then it must be true and none of the internal calls failed.
If transfer(...) returns (i.e. does not revert) then it returns true (never returns false) for any non-empty _tos.
If _tos is non-empty then transfer either reverts or returns true (i.e., it never returns false) — simplified with fewer inputs and a precondition.
